name: Tailwind CSS 4.3 release social card by tailwindcss.com
description: Tailwind's 1200×630 share card reads like an engineering blueprint: the 4.3 release number is extruded as a thin white isometric wireframe with 45°-hatched top faces, floating over a near-black canvas with a faint perspective grid and crosshair ticks. A dense monospace spec panel top-right (title, build channel, language percentages, oversized 4.3 numeral) balances the airy centre, while the cyan wave-mark plus lowercase wordmark anchor bottom-left and a tiny x/y/z axis sketch closes bottom-right. Flat line art, a single sky-blue accent and a huge density contrast between the data table and the empty field carry the whole composition.
